mcpTrackedMetrics.label: Page views
mcpTrackedMetrics.detail: Current MCP endpoints expose relevant content results, not raw page-view telemetry. This shows the number of live content items retrieved for the dashboard topic.

mcpTrackedMetrics.label: Page-view quality
mcpTrackedMetrics.detail: Quality proxy based on metadata coverage and action-oriented guidance in the live MCP result set.

mcpTrackedMetrics.label: Cost avoidance
mcpTrackedMetrics.detail: MCP can identify support and known-issue candidates. Actual cost avoidance needs Content Hub analytics, case deflection, or support-cost telemetry.

mcpTrackedMetrics.label: Content opportunities
mcpTrackedMetrics.detail: Backlog proxy from stale/missing freshness signals, critical source gaps, and weak actionability signals.

mcpTrackedMetrics.label: Traffic sources
mcpTrackedMetrics.detail: MCP currently attributes source-system coverage. LLM traffic, MVP calls, and external referrer attribution require Content Hub traffic telemetry.

mcpTrackedMetrics.label: Freshness signal
mcpTrackedMetrics.detail: Computed from Last Updated metadata when available in the live MCP result excerpts.

mcpTrackedMetrics.label: Content consumption patterns
mcpTrackedMetrics.detail: Shows which content appears for the current topic across connected MCP sources. True consumption patterns need page-view/session telemetry.

mcpTrackedMetrics.label: Source coverage
mcpTrackedMetrics.detail: How many configured MCP source systems are connected and contributing to the health model.
mcpTrackedMetrics.source: LMC: Healthy, SMC: Healthy, Evergreen: Auth needed, CSS Wiki: Not connected

actionDestinations.name: Rubik
actionDestinations.action: Create or update articles and submit downstream PRs
actionDestinations.useWhen: New content or major rewrite is needed

actionDestinations.name: Content Mentor
actionDestinations.action: Select content, improve it, and use guided publishing workflows
actionDestinations.useWhen: Content needs assisted authoring, quality improvement, or publishing

actionDestinations.name: PR review
actionDestinations.action: Review checks, manage PR state, and resolve downstream validation findings

actionDestinations.name: ADO
actionDestinations.action: Track work items, ownership, and backlog follow-through
actionDestinations.useWhen: Action needs assignment, sprint tracking, or dependency management

actionDestinations.name: Freshness Checker
actionDestinations.action: Run a rescan and identify stale content by repository
actionDestinations.useWhen: Freshness or review-date risk is detected

actions.label: Route action to Rubik or Content Mentor
actions.detail: Use Rubik for article creation/PR submission and Content Mentor for assisted authoring, selection, and publishing workflows.

actions.label: Add Content Hub benchmarks
actions.detail: Track PR volume, CPM triage SLA, SME review coverage, page-view quality, cost avoidance, and content opportunities alongside MCP source health.

actions.label: Connect gated sources
actions.detail: Evergreen and CSS Wiki require authorization or endpoint configuration before they can contribute to the model.

actions.label: Review high-risk content
actions.detail: Prioritize rows marked Critical or High, especially pages missing Last Updated metadata.

actions.label: Assign content owners
actions.detail: MCP search results do not expose owners, so ownership should be joined from your governance inventory.

actions.label: Add source metadata
actions.detail: Freshness and owner coverage become stronger when LMC, SMC, Evergreen, and CSS Wiki expose review dates and owners.
